name: M'ONDUNIQ AquametiQ Hydra Prime hydra liquids
shortDescription: Four AquametiQ hydra liquids (treatment solutions) for hydrodermabrasion and aqua peeling devices: A acidic pre-treatment, B hydrating and C brightening (200 ml), D osmotic rinse water (1000 ml).
description:
AquametiQ Hydra Prime is M'ONDUNIQ's professional treatment solution system for hydrogen aqua peeling and hydra-abrasion devices. Each liquid in the system has its own function: A handles acidic preparation, B intensive hydration, Lumio Prime C evens out skin tone, and Osmo Prime D provides the deep-cleansing rinse – together they deliver the full effectiveness of the aqua peeling treatment.

The basic protocol consists of two consecutive phases. The first phase is always a treatment solution with active ingredients: the acidic Hydra Prime A for problem skin prone to oiliness, Lumio Prime C for sensitive, redness-prone or hyperpigmented skin, and the hydrating Hydra Prime B for dehydrated skin. The second phase in every treatment is mandatorily Osmo Prime D. In the protocol that starts with the acidic A, D is followed by targeted active-ingredient delivery matched to the skin's condition: the hydrating B or the brightening C.

Hydra Prime A is an acidic cleansing treatment lotion developed for the effective yet gentle pre-treatment of problem, oily and combination skin. In its 6000 ppm acid complex, mandelic acid (AHA), lactobionic acid and gluconolactone (PHA) work together to loosen dead skin cells and dissolve sebum plugs, so the vacuum cleansing removes comedones and oxidised sebum much more effectively. Due to its larger molecular size, mandelic acid penetrates the skin more slowly, providing more even, gentler exfoliation, while the PHA acids hydrate and provide antioxidant protection. SyriCalm, natural betaine and aloe vera reduce the likelihood of irritation and the tight feeling that can occur during acid treatments.

Hydra Prime B is an ultra-hydrating treatment lotion: in its own protocol it is the first active-ingredient step of the treatment, while in the protocol starting with the acidic A it is the targeted hydrating phase. Hyaluronic acid, the gradual-release Hydromanil complex, Fucogel and aloe vera continuously replenish the skin with moisture during vacuum cleansing, while the micellar cleansing ingredients dissolve sebum, make-up residue and impurities without drying or irritation. Recommended for dehydrated, sensitive skin and skin that has lost its firmness.

Lumio Prime C is a radiance-boosting, skin-tone-evening lotion. The marine-derived Whitonyl (red algae extract) supports the skin's natural radiance, helps even out uneven skin tone and may help reduce the appearance of pigmentation spots. Hyaluronic acid intensely hydrates and plumps fine dehydration lines, while Croton lechleri (Dragon's Blood) extract and aloe vera soothe and provide antioxidant protection. Recommended for the professional treatment of sensitive, redness-prone, couperose, dull and hyperpigmented skin.

Osmo Prime D is a treatment solution produced with reverse osmosis (RO) technology and is the mandatory second phase of every treatment in the AquametiQ protocol. If this step is skipped, the treatment will not be complete: it ensures a thorough flushing of the pores and the deep cleanliness on which subsequent active-ingredient delivery and regenerating treatments can build. During production, bacteria, viruses, heavy metals and the vast majority of the dissolved minerals responsible for limescale are removed from the water, so its minimal mineral content also contributes to a longer service life of the device's tubing, pumps and handpieces.

Hydra Prime A, Hydra Prime B and Lumio Prime C are available in 200 ml, and Osmo Prime D in 1000 ml. All four products are intended exclusively for professional use: recommended for qualified beauty therapists working with aqua peeling systems. The manufacturer recommends purchasing all four liquids so that aqua peeling treatments can cover a salon's full treatment range.

featureRows.headline: A professional, well-structured treatment system
featureRows.subtitle: The professional AquametiQ Hydra Prime protocol uses dedicated treatment solutions for every skin type: each liquid has its own function, and together they deliver the full effectiveness of the aqua peeling treatment.

features.title: Hydra Prime A – the first acidic cleansing step of the aqua peeling treatment, professional pore cleansing with mandelic acid and modern PHA acids
features.description:
The foundation of a perfect aqua peeling treatment is proper preparation. M'ONDUNIQ AquametiQ Hydra Prime A is a professional acidic cleansing treatment lotion developed specifically for the effective yet gentle pre-treatment of problem, oily and combination skin. The 6000 ppm acid complex in the carefully composed formula – mandelic acid, lactobionic acid and gluconolactone – works together to loosen dead skin cells, dissolve sebum plugs and prepare the skin for the deep-cleansing aqua peeling treatment.

Hydra Prime A is not just an acidic liquid. It is the stage of the treatment that lays the foundation for the effectiveness of the entire protocol, because thanks to proper skin preparation the vacuum cleansing can remove impurities and sebum accumulated in the pores much more effectively.

Hydra Prime A plays a key role in treatments where the goal is:

  • regulating sebum production,
  • deep cleansing of the pores,
  • renewing the skin,
  • and the professional preparation of acne-prone skin.

In the very first minutes of the treatment the acids loosen the upper layer of the stratum corneum, so during hydrogen aqua peeling the vacuum can remove comedones, oxidised sebum and impurities deposited on the skin surface much more effectively. As a result, the treatment outcome is more visible, and the skin becomes smoother, clearer and more even.

Modern acid technology, even for more sensitive skin

The Hydra Prime A formula was designed to provide both an effective keratolytic action and high skin comfort. Compared with classic AHA acids, mandelic acid penetrates the skin more slowly due to its larger molecular size, providing more even, gentler exfoliation while offering excellent sebum-regulating properties. The PHA acids – lactobionic acid and gluconolactone – further enhance the skin-renewing effect while intensely hydrating and providing antioxidant protection, making the treatment less irritating than traditional acid protocols.
features.highlight: Its role: it loosens the keratinised layer, dissolves sebum, prepares the pores and makes vacuum deep cleansing significantly more effective. This is the first active-ingredient step for problem, oily and combination skin.

features.title: Hydra Prime B – intensive hydration and skin preparation in a single treatment solution
features.description:
A truly effective aqua peeling treatment is about more than mechanically cleansing the skin. Professional results are built on the right treatment solutions, which actively support the skin's function at the same time as the vacuum cleansing. M'ONDUNIQ AquametiQ Hydra Prime B fulfils exactly this role. It is the system's first active-ingredient treatment solution, which intensely hydrates, soothes and prepares the skin for the further treatment phases right from the start of the treatment.

Enriched with hyaluronic acid, the Hydromanil hydrating complex, aloe vera and Fucogel, the formula not only cleanses but immediately begins replenishing the skin with moisture, so the treatment becomes genuine skincare within the first few minutes.

Why is this one of the most important steps of the treatment?

During aqua peeling the skin is cleansed under a continuous flow of liquid. If only purified water were used at this point, the treatment would lack the professional supply of active ingredients that truly makes the difference between an average and a premium treatment. With Hydra Prime B, the skin encounters valuable hydrating and soothing ingredients from the very first moment of the vacuum treatment. This ensures that cleansing does not merely remove impurities but continuously supports the skin's comfort and natural protective barrier at the same time.

In its own protocol, Hydra Prime B is step 1, i.e. the active-ingredient hydrating treatment. This is the stage where the skin receives its first professional hydration and preparation. During vacuum cleansing, the device continuously delivers the hydrating active ingredients to the skin, supporting its natural water balance and comfort.
features.highlight: As a result, the client experiences noticeably softer, plumper and more hydrated skin already in the first phase of the treatment.

features.title: Lumio Prime C – professional skin-brightening and skin-tone-evening lotion
features.description:
M'ONDUNIQ AquametiQ Lumio Prime C is a professional radiance-boosting and skin-smoothing lotion developed specifically for treatments with aqua peeling devices. This special concentrate is one of the key steps of the hydrafacial treatment: it intensely hydrates the previously cleansed skin, unifies skin tone and supports the skin's natural regeneration. It is especially recommended for the professional treatment of sensitive, redness-prone, couperose, dull and hyperpigmented skin.

The innovative active ingredients of the formula hydrate, soothe and contribute to a more radiant, fresher-looking skin at the same time. After the treatment the skin feels smoother, looks fresher and has a more even tone, while its comfort also improves significantly.

Why use it during hydra treatments?

AquametiQ Lumio Prime C is not just a hydrating solution but a professional treatment solution that supports the skin's regeneration after hydra-abrasion and prepares it for optimal absorption of further active ingredients. In addition to intensive hydration and antioxidant protection, it helps reduce the tired, dull appearance of the skin, so the final result of the treatment is visibly more radiant and even.

Lumio Prime C – active cleansing and skin preparation

  • Used together with hydra-abrasion, it removes surface impurities and dead skin cells.
  • Already in this phase it delivers intensive hydrating and skin-brightening active ingredients into the skin.
  • It prepares the skin for deeper cleansing and the next treatment steps.
  • Especially recommended for sensitive, redness-prone and pigmented skin.

Lumio Prime C is therefore not a simple cleansing liquid but a hydrating, skin-tone-evening treatment solution enriched with active ingredients that is already at work in the first phase of cleansing. The vacuum of the hydra device helps hyaluronic acid, Whitonyl, Dragon's Blood extract and aloe vera come into contact with the freshly exfoliated skin right at the start of the treatment.
features.highlight: Lumio Prime C does more than cleanse the skin: from the very first minute of the treatment it supports hydration, radiance and comfort with active ingredients. This turns the first cleansing step into the first intensive skincare treatment as well.

features.title: Osmo Prime D – the indispensable second step of professional aqua peeling treatments
features.description:
Truly spectacular aqua peeling results are not a matter of chance – they come from a precisely structured treatment protocol. AquametiQ Osmo Prime D is a professional treatment solution produced with reverse osmosis (RO) technology, developed specifically for the second treatment phase of AquametiQ Hydra Prime and other professional hydra systems.

This is the step where the real power of hydra technology shows. While the first treatment phase prepares and loosens the skin surface, with Osmo Prime D the device's intensive vacuum technology effectively removes dissolved sebum, dead skin cells, impurities trapped in the pores and deposits on the skin surface. This is the treatment stage that delivers the iconic deep-cleansing result of professional aqua peeling treatments.

If this step is skipped, the treatment will not be complete. In the AquametiQ treatment protocol, Osmo Prime D is the mandatory second phase of every treatment, as it ensures the cleanliness and surface renewal on which subsequent active-ingredient delivery and regenerating treatments can build.

The liquid contains water purified by reverse osmosis, from which bacteria, viruses, heavy metals and the vast majority of the dissolved minerals responsible for limescale are removed during production. As a result, it not only provides an ideal treatment medium but also contributes to the long-term, reliable operation of the hydra system.

Why is Osmo Prime D indispensable?

  • the mandatory second treatment phase of professional aqua peeling treatments
  • the essential treatment solution of deep-cleansing hydra treatments
  • supports thorough cleansing of the pores
  • helps remove dead skin cells and impurities
  • contributes to a smoother, fresher and more radiant complexion
  • provides a perfect base for the next treatment steps and the application of active ingredients
  • high-purity treatment solution produced by reverse osmosis
  • thanks to its minimal mineral content, helps reduce limescale build-up
  • contributes to a longer service life of the device's tubing, pumps and handpieces
  • developed for professional use

One of the secrets of a perfect aqua peeling

The effectiveness of professional hydra treatments is determined not only by the device but also by the quality of the treatment solutions used and precise adherence to the treatment protocol. AquametiQ Osmo Prime D is one of the most important elements of the hydra treatment, providing the deep-cleansing phase on which every successful aqua peeling treatment is built.
features.highlight: Because real results always start with the right protocol.

faq.question: How is the Hydra Prime protocol structured?
faq.answer: The professional AquametiQ Hydra Prime treatment protocol consists of two consecutive phases. 1. A – acidic preparation and pore loosening (for problem skin). 2. D – osmotic water, deep cleansing and rinsing (a mandatory step in every treatment). 3. B or C – targeted active-ingredient delivery according to the skin's condition. Depending on the skin's needs: B – ultra-hydrating lotion (dehydrated, sensitive skin), C – brightening, skin-tone-evening lotion (hyperpigmented, sensitive, redness-prone skin). This is a professional, well-structured treatment system in which each liquid has its own function, and together they deliver the full effectiveness of the aqua peeling treatment.

faq.question: Why is Osmo Prime D the mandatory second step?
faq.answer: It is not a conventional active-ingredient concentrate but high-purity osmotic water that ensures optimal device operation, supports deep pore cleansing, flushes out dissolved impurities and sebum, and promotes the maximum effectiveness of hydrogen aqua peeling. Together with the vacuum of the hydra system, it deeply flushes the pores and washes out the loosened sebum, impurities and the skin cells shed during the first step – this provides the deep cleanliness that is the basis of a professional aqua peeling treatment. The osmotic water used in the second treatment phase also supports an even and hygienic execution of the treatment. Without Hydra Prime D the treatment would not be complete, as it ensures proper rinsing and the optimal operation of hydrogen cleansing. Together, the two liquids form the professional system that makes aqua peeling both highly effective and gentle.

faq.question: What skin do we recommend Hydra Prime A for?
faq.answer: M'ONDUNIQ AquametiQ Hydra Prime A is especially recommended for oily skin, combination skin, acne-prone skin, skin with enlarged pores, seborrhoeic skin, skin with blackheads, as well as dull skin with a thickened stratum corneum. Hydra Prime A is one of the most important liquids of the Hydra Prime acid treatment system, significantly increasing the effectiveness of aqua peeling treatments in a professional setting. Thanks to the coordinated action of modern AHA and PHA acids and soothing plant actives, the skin is cleansed already in the first step of the treatment, prepared for deeper pore cleansing and brought into an optimal state for the next phases of the Hydra Prime system.

faq.question: What treatments do we recommend Hydra Prime B for?
faq.answer: M'ONDUNIQ AquametiQ Hydra Prime B is recommended for every professional hydrogen aqua peeling treatment where the goal is not only to cleanse the skin but also to hydrate and condition it at the same time. It is especially recommended for dehydrated skin, sensitive skin, skin lacking moisture, skin that has lost its firmness, revitalising dull, lifeless skin, and as the first treatment step of any professional aqua peeling treatment. Hydra Prime B is the indispensable first treatment solution of the Hydra Prime treatment system: thanks to its carefully composed active-ingredient complex, the treatment becomes not simple cleansing but a genuine hydrating and skin-conditioning experience. If your goal is to offer a premium aqua peeling treatment that delivers visible and tangible results from the very first step, using Hydra Prime B is practically essential.

faq.question: When should you choose Lumio Prime C?
faq.answer: Professional areas of application: during AquametiQ Hydra Prime treatments, for revitalising dull, lifeless skin, for treating hyperpigmented skin and uneven skin tone, for caring for sensitive, redness-prone skin, as part of intensive hydrating and radiance-boosting hydra treatments, and in treatment protocols aimed at a smoother, fresher and more even complexion. A product developed for professional use, recommended exclusively with aqua peeling systems and for qualified beauty therapists.

faq.question: What sizes are available, and who can use them?
faq.answer: Hydra Prime A: 200 ml. Hydra Prime B: 200 ml. Lumio Prime C: 200 ml. Osmo Prime D: 1000 ml. All four treatment solutions are intended exclusively for professional use and are recommended for qualified beauty therapists working with aqua peeling systems.

faq.question: Why is it worth buying all four treatment solutions?
faq.answer: We recommend purchasing all 4 products (A, B, C, D) so that aqua peeling treatments can cover your entire salon range. The professional AquametiQ Hydra Prime protocol uses dedicated treatment solutions for every skin type, so for every skin condition there is a suitable active first step (A, B or C) and the corresponding mandatory second, rinsing phase (D).

faq.question: Which devices are these treatment solutions for?
faq.answer: The treatment solutions were developed for professional aqua peeling and hydra-abrasion devices: for the AquametiQ Hydra Prime system and other professional hydra systems. During hydrogen aqua peeling the skin is cleansed under a continuous flow of liquid, so the effectiveness of the treatment is determined not only by the device but also by the quality of the treatment solutions used and precise adherence to the treatment protocol.
